pending_interview.category: Martech/AI-product — personalization architecture, attribution modeling, GenAI content pipelines, measurement under privacy constraints
pending_interview.question: A B2C retailer has a robust email personalization engine that uses collaborative filtering to drive product recommendations. They now want to layer in a generative AI component to write individualized email copy for each customer segment — but they're also facing tightening privacy regulations that are limiting the customer data signals they're allowed to use. How would you design a personalization and measurement architecture that delivers meaningfully better outcomes than their current system, while respecting those data constraints? Walk through your approach to both the content generation pipeline and how you'd attribute revenue impact to the new AI-driven copy.
